text:
alyssa: Heads up — just noticed a sustained p99 TTFT spike in eu-west around 15:20 UTC (p50 fine, p95 ~ normal). p99 jumped from ~400ms to ~1.8s for ~25m. tokens/sec dropped ~30% at same time. :eyes:

jordan: saw that in alerts too. queue_length for gpu_pool_eu increased, backlog spiked. looks like requests were piling while autoscaler lagged.

kevin: can you paste the grafana panel query? want to check if it's request queueing or slow model kernels.

alyssa: here's the PromQL I used for the TTFT histogram panel:```histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))```and tokens/sec:```sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (region)```

marc: also correlate with `gpu_queue_length{pool="eu-west"}` and `instance_gpu_utilization`. if util low but queue high it's a scheduling issue.

ops-bot: [alert] TTFT_P99_eu-west firing (1774001248) - p99 > 1.5s for 5m - severity: high

jordan: quick check on infra — autoscaler logs show a 90s cooldown that prevented an extra node from joining during the burst. we had a short provisioning error: `k8s: failed attach volume` around 15:18 then retried.

kevin: ok that matches. provisioning lag -> queue build -> p99 spike. two things to consider: lower cooldown for dedicated pools, or add buffer nodes (warm capacity) for peak hours. both affect cost.

alyssa: cost question — how many warm nodes would we need to keep p99 under 1s during similar bursts? rough calc: tokens/sec dropped 30%, queue peaked at ~1200 requests. avg req tokens ~600. suggests needing ~4 additional A100-equivalent slots for that window.

marc: instead of always-on nodes, maybe add short-lived warmers: keep 2 warm and allow quick burst to 6 via faster attach path (we can optimize CSI attach path). also bump our `scaleDownUnneededTime` from 10m to 3m for these pools.

jordan: on alert side, we should tune TTFT_P99_eu-west to fire for 10m and include tokens/sec drop as a dependency to reduce noisy alerts during small blips. propose: fire when p99>1.2s AND tokens/sec decreased by >20% over 5m.

kevin: agree. add a recording rule for `region:inference_request_duration_seconds:histogram_quantile_0.99` to reduce load on Grafana queries. also add `increase(tokens_generated_total[5m])` as a series for alert math.

alyssa: I'll open a short runbook: steps to triage p99 spikes (check queue, attach errors, autoscaler cooldown, tokens/sec). Also will add a dashboard panel that drills from p50/p95/p99 down to per-model and per-instance.

ops-bot: dashboard-create: `sre/p99-drill-eu-west` created (1774001267) by alyssa

marc: can someone add a note to SLO docs re: regional warm capacity and expected cost impact? want product + finance to see tradeoffs before we change reserved capacity.

kevin: I'll prototype a Prometheus alert rule and a Grafana drilldown together. will post PR for review later today.

alyssa: thanks — tagging @marc @kevin. I'll paste the runbook draft in #eng-sre-runbooks when ready. :thumbsup:

jordan: quick follow: we've seen similar pattern once in ap-south during a deploy that changed model quantization fallback. we should also validate model fallback didn't increase per-token decoding time (quantized -> fallback to fp16 can be slower unexpectedly). check model_variant label in traces.

alyssa: good call — will check traces for `model_variant` and `quant_mode` flags. if fallback is culprit we may need per-variant SLOs.

kevin: also add a graph for `kv_cache_hit_ratio` by region; low cache hits can massively increase tokens/sec cost and TTFT.

marc: summary action items: 1) alyssa runbook + dashboard drill 2) kevin prometheus recording + alert PR 3) jordan investigate attach/CNI failures and suggest faster attach path 4) ops: evaluate warm-node economics for eu-west peak window.

alyssa: noted. I'll start with the runbook + dashboard. will update thread when done.

ops-bot: [action created] SRE-452: investigate eu-west p99 provisioning and warm nodes (assignee: marc)

kevin: I'll link the PR here once I have the rules: example alert draft:```- alert: TTFT_P99_Regional
  expr: (
    region:inference_request_duration_seconds:histogram_quantile_0.99 > 1.2
  ) and on(region) (
    (sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[5m])) by (region) < (sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[30m])) by (region) * 0.8))
  )
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

jordan: looks good. +1 for the `for: 10m`. avoids flapping.

alyssa: thanks — closing loop soon.
